name: MIEBO
indications_original:
MIEBO
 
  ®(perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution) is indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease (DED).
contraindications_original: Instill one drop of MIEBO four times daily into each eye. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
MIEBO
 
  ®(perfluorohexyloctane ophthalmic solution) is supplied as a sterile, clear and colorless liquid in multiple-dose 5 mL polypropylene bottles with dropper tips and screw caps, packaged in a carton - NDC 24208-377-05.

 
                  
                     Storage
                  
                  Store MIEBO at 15ºC to 25ºC (59ºF to 77ºF). After opening, MIEBO can be used until the expiration date on the bottle.
